description: Check a tracking domain's CNAME record now, instead of waiting for the hourly check. A verified domain is turned off only when DNS answers that the record is gone or points somewhere else, never because DNS did not answer. Once the record verifies, we also check within minutes that our end serves the name over HTTPS, then every hour; `inUse` says when campaigns use it, and `dnsHost` says where its DNS lives while it is not verified (as list_tracking_domains describes). A workspace can newly verify at most 10 hostnames per 30 days; past that, a check that would verify answers 429 until the oldest of those verifications is 30 days old (`details.resetAt` says when), and nothing is verified. The answer carries the same `records` as list_tracking_domains. Use each row's `check` and `observed` to see what DNS answered; if it did not answer, retry later rather than replacing the record.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
